ref_file_title: HJ16 - Verifiable Random Functions from Standard Assumptions
note: Verified against vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib entry TCC:HofJag16 (LNCS 9562 pp. 336–362, DOI 10.1007/978-3-662-49096-9_14; use cryptobib_key TCC:HofJag16) and the eprint 2015/1048 abstract: first VRF with exponential-size input space and full adaptive security from a non-interactive constant-size assumption; instantiable in groups with a symmetric bilinear map under any member of the (n-1)-linear family with n >= 3, i.e. k-Lin for k >= 2, including DLIN.

ref_file_title: HN24 - One-Way Functions and Zero Knowledge
note: Verified by the verifier against cryptobib entry STOC:HirNan24 (authors, pages 1731-1738, DOI match); use cryptobib_key: STOC:HirNan24. Also ECCC TR24-063 and a SICOMP journal version (DOI 10.1137/24M1689971). Abstract (via search snippets; ACM/ECCC/SIAM hosts blocked) states the equivalence: a one-way function exists iff NP is contained in CZK and NP is hard in the worst case (iff CZK is hard in the worst case and GapMCSP is in CZK).

ref_file_title: HRSS17 - High-Speed Key Encapsulation from NTRU
authors: Andreas Hülsing, Joost Rijneveld, John M. Schanck, Peter Schwabe
note: cryptobib_key: CHES:HRSS17 (verified in vendor/cryptobib); eprint 2017/667. Abstract (via search snippet): simplified textbook NTRU, parameters at the 128-bit post-quantum level, 'a KEM that is CCA2-secure in the quantum random oracle model'. Became the NTRU-HRSS component of the NIST submission NTRU.
